s: In which place the Dutch east India Company established its first factory in Andhra Desa
x:
The Dutch East India Company (VOC) established its first factory in Andhra Pradesh at Machilipatnam (Masulipatnam) in the early 17th century. Machilipatnam was one of the most important ports on the Coromandel Coast and was famous for its export of cotton textiles, dyed fabrics, spices and indigo. The Dutch selected the port because of its flourishing overseas trade and strategic location. Later, they also established trading centres at Pulicat, Nizampatnam and other coastal towns.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (2).
n: First Dutch Factory in Andhra – Machilipatnam

s: Which port town was famous for the handloom trade in the 16th and 17th centuries A.D.?
x:
Machilipatnam (Masulipatnam) was the most famous textile-exporting port on the Coromandel Coast during the 16th and 17th centuries. The town became internationally renowned for its cotton textiles, dyed fabrics, painted cloth (Chintz), muslins and handloom products, which were exported to Europe, Arabia, Persia and Southeast Asia. The Portuguese, Dutch, English and French established trading centres here because of its thriving textile industry. Machilipatnam played a major role in the commercial history of Andhra and became one of the most prosperous ports during the medieval period.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).

s: What was the headquarters of the Dutch East India Company's establishments in India?
x:
The Dutch East India Company (VOC) was established in 1602 to conduct trade in Asia. Initially, the Dutch established trading factories at Masulipatnam, Pulicat, Nagapattinam, and other ports. Among these, Nagapattinam became the chief administrative headquarters of the Dutch settlements in India. From here, the Dutch supervised their commercial activities on the Coromandel Coast, especially the export of textiles, spices, indigo and other commodities. Although Masulipatnam was the first Dutch factory in Andhra, Nagapattinam later became the headquarters.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
